secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Format: https://xxxx.supabase.co. When set, backend uses Supabase Auth.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (Dashboard → Project Settings → API). Railway only — never in frontend or GitHub.

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase PostgreSQL pooler connection string (aws-0-sa-east-1.pooler.supabase.com:6543). Falls back to local Docker PostgreSQL if unreachable.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase URL for frontend (same as SUPABASE_URL). Enables Supabase Auth + Storage in the frontend.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon key for frontend Auth + Storage.

secrets.name: VITE_API_URL
secrets.description: Railway backend URL for frontend API calls. Empty for local dev (uses Vite proxy).

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for transactional email notifications (https://resend.com/api-keys).

secrets.name: EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: Sender email for notifications. Example: D'Helenas <noreply@dhelenas.com.br>

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: WhatsApp Business Cloud API access token (Meta Business → WhatsApp → API Setup).

secrets.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
secrets.description: WhatsApp Business phone number ID (Meta Business → WhatsApp → API Setup).

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret key for signing JWT auth tokens in local dev. Auto-generated; not used when SUPABASE_URL is set.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Admin user password for the seed script. Used to create the admin@dhelenas.com account. Never hardcode — set via Secrets dashboard.
